$comment: Shimla ke ilaake. Har district ka apna mizaaj, police density aur gameplay rule hai.

districts.name: The Mall & Ridge
districts.vibe: Colonial heart. Gaiety, Christ Church, Scandal Point.
districts.note: Asli Shimla mein Mall Road pe gaadi ban hai - sirf paidal. Game mein bhi: gaadi lekar ghuse to seedha 2-star wanted.

districts.name: Lakkar Bazaar
districts.vibe: Lakdi ka bazaar, bheed, sankri galiyan.

districts.name: Jakhoo Hill
districts.vibe: Deodar ka jungle, Hanuman mandir, bandar hi bandar. Sheher ka sabse uncha point.

districts.name: Sanjauli
districts.vibe: Sabse ghana bharaa suburb. Tang galiyan, ek ke upar ek ghar. Vicky ka ghar.

districts.name: Dhalli
districts.vibe: Sheher ka poorvi darwaza. Apple mandi, truck, timber depot.

districts.name: Kasumpti & New Shimla
districts.vibe: Naya planned sector. Chaudi sadkein - racing ke liye best.

districts.name: Chaura Maidan & Vidhan Sabha
districts.vibe: Sarkari Shimla. Vidhan Sabha, Secretariat, VIP convoy.

districts.name: Railway Station & Cart Road
districts.vibe: Kalka-Shimla toy train ka terminus. Coolie, cargo, goods shed.

districts.name: Tutikandi ISBT
districts.vibe: HRTC ka adda. Bus, dhaba, taxi union.

districts.name: Viceregal Lodge
districts.vibe: 1888 ka Rashtrapati Niwas. Manicured lawn, guard, ooncha gate.

districts.name: Annandale
districts.vibe: Shimla ka ek maatra samtal maidan. Helipad, cricket, Army ground.

districts.name: Water Catchment Forest
districts.vibe: Ghana deodar jungle, wildlife sanctuary. Timber mafia ka shikaar-gah.
